QuestInfo.name: Jane Doe's Request
QuestInfo.0: Something about Naora Hospital makes this place look so eerie and spooky.\r\nCheck it out...if you dare!
QuestInfo.1: #p1052105# wants to see how her surgery came out, but she doesn't have a mirror to look at herself with. She wants you to eliminate #r150 Wraiths#k and bring her #b60 Broken Mirror Glasses#k.
QuestInfo.2: You collected Broken Mirror Glasses for Jane Doe. Good luck putting them all together...

0.0: Hello...? Wh-why is this place so cold?\r\nWhere is Dr. Naora...? I'm supposed to get my bandages off today... Where did my doctor go...?

yes.0: Thank...you. I want to take these bandages off...and see myself in a mirror...but all of the mirrors went away. I hear...the Wraiths in the Subway...carry Broken Mirror Glasses. Would you...#beliminate...150 Wraiths and bring me 60 Broken Mirror Glasses#k...?

1.0: It's all broken...but it will do.
1.1: Thank you... I want to get my bandages off...and go home. It's so cold here...

yes.0: AAAH! Wh-what is this...? I can't...see myself in the mirror...? Does that mean... Am I a ghost...? No! I'm n-not ready to be a ghost...yet!
yes.1: How would you like it if YOU were a ghost...?

default.0: Please eliminate...#r150 Wraiths#k...and bring me #b60 Broken Mirror Glasses#k.

item.0: I still need...#b60 Broken Mirror Glasses#k... Why is it so cold...?
